classification: Display-only routing study; no physical fit, bend radius, cable cut length or fabrication claim

piece_grouping_basis.basis: Allocation of the two documented6-conductor pieces to the only12-pad group J3 follows the documented counts and actual row; this split assignment is a reconstruction inference, not an independently measured installed cable.
piece_grouping_basis.black_stripe_for_second_J3_half: If rendering two adjacent6-conductor ribbons, mark the low-number edge of each corresponding half consistently at both ends. The second half begins at overallJ3.7; its exact historical ink placement is unmeasured.

routing_parameters.midspan_pitch: Independent display wires use a transported fanout row to preserve separation and numbered endpoints. Actual 2.54 mm pad pitch is retained at ends; its continuation through the study is a display assumption, not physical ribbon web/pitch evidence.
routing_parameters.bend_radius: Unqualified display path; no manufacturer bend radius available
